run_simCLR_hltm_training: run the simCLR HLTM training pipeline with hydra config to train a hierarchical latent tree model
create_Latent_hierarchy: create a Latent hierarchy tree with configurable depth, num_children, and delta probability tables
build_Model_forward: build a Model that performs bottom-up forward pass through a hierarchical latent tree and normalizes output
computeJ_Jacobian: compute the top-down Jacobian of each latent node through the hierarchical tree using Model.computeJ
generate_SimpleDataset_samples: generate synthetic dataset samples using SimpleDataset with top-down latent variable generation and positive negative pairs
